sentences.text: 3. In the course of hearing of the bail application, Mr. D.K.Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that all the material witnesses have already been examined in this case, but the petitioner is languishing in jail custody since 26.02.2022 and, therefore, by taking into account the humanitarian ground, the petitioner may kindly be directed to be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, Mr.S.R.Roul, learned ASC by drawing attention of the Court to the eight criminal antecedents of the petitioner prays to reject his bail application.
It is relevant to mention here that the learned counsel for the petitioner has also enclosed the photocopy of certified copy of depositions of witnesses examined in the trial of the case.

opennyai_summary.decision:
After having considered the rival submissions made and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of accusations raised against the petitioner and on going through the evidence of the victim and regard being had to the number of criminal antecedents of the Petitioner, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the present petitioner.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stand disposed of.
